name: Adam

skills.name: Bounty Lock
skills.description: Fires a tracking round at the enemy Hero without Hunter's Mark closest to the center of the enemy team. The shot applies Hunter's Mark and deals 257,905 damage. If the target dies while affected by Hunter's Mark, the ability is immediately reset.

skills.name: Fan the Hammer
skills.damage_formula: Damage to main target: 78,990 (80% physical attack + 100 * level + 100). Damage to marked target: 46,045 (40% physical attack + 100 * level + 100). Cooldown: 7s
skills.description: Fires a series of 3 shots at the nearest enemy, dealing 78,990 damage with each shot. If there are enemies on the battlefield with Hunter's Mark, the shots ricochet to them, dealing 46,045 damage. Cooldown: 7s

skills.name: Reactive Screen
skills.damage_formula: Additional dodge: 13,436 (10% physical attack + 40 * level). Cooldown: 10s
skills.description: Once every 10s, when Adam takes damage from enemies, a smoke screen is deployed beneath him for 5s. While inside the smoke screen, Adam gains 13,436 additional dodge and can evade all types of damage, not just physical. Cooldown: 10s

skills.name: Adaptive Caliber
skills.damage_formula: Physical Attack increase: 4,707 (0.9% health + 5 * level). Armor Penetration increase: 3,533 (3.5% physical attack + 5 * level)
skills.description: Passive skill. When Adam deals physical damage and does not fully penetrate the target's armor, his Armor Penetration increases by 3,533. If Adam fully penetrates the target's armor, his Physical Attack increases by 4,707. Both effects stack and last until the end of the battle.

skins.name: Ceremonial Skin
skins.note: Can only be obtained during a special event (May 24)

lore: The universe is a big place - there's always work for a bounty hunter. Adam is one of the best, and nothing pleased him more than the sound of space credits pouring into his account. A contract on the deserter Arachne led him to Dominion. Just as he was about to pull the trigger, the Guardians appealed to his better nature. Not everyone with a bounty on their head deserves to die. Canceling the contract, Adam joined the Guardians. After all, work is sweeter when your consciousness is clean - and Dominion gold beats space credits every time.
presentation: A marksman who attacks the enemy center, becomes more powerful as the combat drags on, gifted with a survival skill to last until the end. He is yet another effort of Nexters to slow down the pace of battles, after Fluffy, Electra and Byrna. This is why we have seen stalling teams come back into fashion recently.

synergies_detail.description: Lyria binds herself to the ally with the highest physical attack for 12 seconds. Both Lyria and the bonded ally receive a vampirism bonus. While the Bonds of Alliance are active, vampirism restores health for them both. If the bonded ally is undead, they both get a physical attack bonus.

Passive skill. The hero exudes an aura that decreases the dodge stat of all enemies within the area of effect. All affected enemies receive additional physical damage from physical attacks. The size of the aura scales with the number of undead units in allied team.
Deals damage to the nearest enemies and transforms a percentage of damage dealt into Health.

Polaris unleashes the Northern Lights onto her enemies. Her allies' control effects last 5% longer when applied to the affected foes. The Northern Lights also decrease the level of enemy skills that have a chance of activating by 10.
Enchants the weapon wielded by the ally Fafnir is forging a Runic Shield for, increasing damage from their physical attacks for 8 seconds.
Iris exposes an unprotected part of the Soul in the nearest enemy's body for 13 seconds. All damage taken by the Soul is transferred to its owner as pure damage.

counters_detail.description: When an enemy uses an ultimate ability, Fluffy cancels it and deals damage to them. At the same time, Fluffy takes damage equal to 33.5% of his maximum Health. This ability can trigger once every 20 seconds. The chance to cancel an ultimate ability is reduced if the target's level exceeds 40.
counters_detail.notes: Fluffy directly cancels Adam's Bounty Lock ultimate, preventing Hunter's Mark from being applied and shutting down his entire damage scaling loop.
